# Repository Description

## Suggested GitHub Repository Description

**C++ Pacman game with advanced AI strategies, save/load functionality, and multi-level support. Features intelligent ghost behavior using BFS algorithms, complete gameplay recording system, and console-based interface.**

## Key Features for Repository Highlights

- **Advanced AI**: Three difficulty levels with BFS pathfinding
- **Game Recording**: Complete save/load system for gameplay analysis  
- **Multi-level Support**: Multiple pre-designed game boards
- **Object-oriented Design**: Clean C++ architecture with design patterns
- **Cross-platform**: Windows console application with color support
